title: Codified governance rules manifest
description: Maps source markdown paths to committed rule pack directories and content hashes.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) the manifest was built from

commit_sha.description: Resolved commit SHA at ref when manifest was updated

updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of last manifest update

doc_path.description: Relative path to source markdown (e.g. governance/priority-controls.md)

pack_dir.description: Relative path to rule pack directory under rules/

content_sha256.description: SHA256 of markdown content at codify time

source_ref.description: Git ref used when this entry was codified
